outcome: Deliver the supplied RM09 operator portal against real Management/RM08 APIs, with one versioned UI design approval before production UI and truthful authorization, mutation/recovery and configuration journeys.

scope.description: Preserve and import RM09, reconcile current contracts, prepare bounded tasks, generate classified backoffice wireframes and a versioned visible design pack; pause for exact human design approval.

Small additive canonical search/environment, human/delegated identity, scoped configuration eligibility and trusted cohort discovery prerequisites, existing server/client/provider boundaries and tests.
Separate approved Next.js/TypeScript portal, authentication/session server integration, typed client reuse, application/metadata/configuration/adoption/recovery UI and its tests/guidance.
Focused existing provider/service/browser/accessibility/visual checks, local runnable example, exact installation/intake evidence and deployment/agent guidance with honest external-proof limits.

constraints: Current user explicitly authorizes this next RM09 work and pauses only for UI screenshot-preview approval. Codex selects finite limits and organizes tasks; this is not a claim of a separate human numerical-profile review.

Production UI and production write-flow wiring wait for one exact persisted CIS wireframe/design approval. A material changed journey requires approval of that revised design; routine workflow-preserving fixes do not.
Classify every UI surface as backoffice; preserve portable clients, independent Next.js host, native management authority and existing original transaction/recovery/Audit boundaries.

Use one shared allocation across all agents, already-performed intake, implementation, tests, documentation, design and review. Preserve all previous changes, consumed costs, reports, completed owners and protected launch settings.

Existing physical6GiB consumer ceiling and64MiB reserve remain one containing limit across old and new files; the existing2GiB Docker allowance stays inside it. No existing database access, credential access, trust-store change or external deployment is authorized.

Retain protected historical README/AGENTS/profile inputs unless a necessary explicitly scoped implementation change supersedes them; preserve original hashes/reports and do not reopen completed test owners.
No push, merge or release of RM09 work is included. No new generic framework, test harness, graph engine, design-management platform or tooling campaign.

Local token/protocol tests cannot be reported as a live Entra deployment. Dependency/runtime pins must be supported and checked before use; no production dependency installation is needed for the design preview.
